# Feature request

## Summary
Describe the feature and the problem it solves.

## Goals
- [ ] User value / business outcome
- [ ] Success metrics

## Non-Goals
List what is explicitly out of scope.

## User Story
As a ___, I want ___, so that ___.

## Proposed Solution
High-level approach, UX changes, or API updates.

## Dependencies
- Other teams, services, or systems
- Data or analytics needs

## Launch Phase Alignment
Which launch phase does this support? Reference `docs/launch/PHASES.md`.

## Risks & Mitigations
Call out any risks (reference `docs/launch/PHASES.md` risk register if relevant).
